Foundry Commercial's investment management arm has closed its third opportunistic real estate fund at $120m, raising almost five times the capital secured for its predecessor vehicle three years ago.

Nordic private equity firm Celero Capital has closed its second buyout fund at an increased €425m hard cap, growing its flagship strategy by 55% less than two years after completing its debut fundraise.

KKR has completed its $5.7bn acquisition of medical device manufacturer Integer Holdings, taking the US-listed business private following shareholder approval of the transaction last month.

European venture capital deals involving private equity investors have seen median company valuations more than double this year, despite a much weaker recovery across the wider market, according to new PitchBook research.

Pantheon has agreed a €548m infrastructure secondary transaction with Natixis Investment Managers affiliate Mirova, providing liquidity to existing fund investors while bringing fresh capital into a portfolio of European renewable energy businesses.

The New York State Teachers' Retirement System has unveiled more than $1bn of new private markets commitments alongside an update that its venture capital and growth equity investments continue to underperform their benchmarks.

Venture capital fund-of-funds manager Allocator One has emerged from stealth after closing its inaugural flagship vehicle above target, with total commitments across its investment vehicles exceeding $100m.

Detroit-based Mudita Venture Partners has closed its second fund at $120m, tripling the size of its debut vehicle as it expands its investments in early-stage business-to-business AI companies.

Lovell Minnick has named Jason Barg as its next co-managing partner as part of a wider leadership reshuffle that will see longtime co-head Bob Belke step back from the role ahead of his retirement at the end of 2027.
